title: Luthen Rael
description: Luthen Rael owned Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest on Coruscant. He used the location as a front for working as part of the Rebel Alliance to overthrow the Galactic Empire. Rael placed Cassian Andor on the Aldhani heist team. Though he considered killing Andor to cover the Rebellion's tracks, he decided against it.
